description.text: The twelfth set of the EX series, released in February 2006 with 93 cards, 92 numbered and a secret Pikachu, and two theme decks, Groundbreaker and Shadowquake. It is set in a forest where legendary Pokémon live, Mew among them, and it brought in React Energy, which some Pokémon turn into extra effects. It was meant to come out before EX Delta Species and swapped places with it, so its only Delta Species Pokémon is that secret Pikachu. Regice, Regirock and Registeel are its Pokémon Star.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets
